name: Malloti
title: Levitical singer and musician
summary: Malloti was a Levite from the family of Heman who was appointed to temple service as a singer and musician under King David. He was one of Heman's sons and was assigned the twenty-fourth lot for service in the temple. His role was connected with praise and worship in the sanctuary.

siblings: Hananiah, son of Zerubbabel, descendant of David

keyEvents.title: Appointment to Temple Service
keyEvents.description: Mallothi was appointed as one of Heman's sons to serve with song and music in the temple, under King David's leadership.

keyEvents.title: The Twenty-Fourth Lot
keyEvents.description: Mallothi received the nineteenth lot for his service rotation in the temple, along with his sons and brothers, twelve in total.

keyEvents.title: Organization of Temple Singing
keyEvents.description: David and the commanders set apart Heman's sons, including Mallothi, for service with prophetic singing accompanied by harps, lyres, and cymbals.

keyEvents.title: Service under Heman's Leadership
keyEvents.description: Malloti served under the guidance of his father Heman, who was the king's seer and was exalted by God with fourteen sons and three daughters.
